findings.title: `queued` default timestamp is evaluated once at import time instead of per instance
findings.body: `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` in the `AssignmentSource` dataclass evaluates `timezone.now()` a single time when the module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` instance created without an explicit `queued` argument will share the exact same timestamp from process startup. Use `dataclasses.field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so the current time is captured when each instance is constructed.

findings.title: Passing `assignment_source` to `installation.sync_assignee_outbound` breaks integrations that do not accept `**kwargs`
findings.body: `sync_assignee_outbound` passes `assignment_source=parsed_assignment_source` as a keyword argument to `installation.sync_assignee_outbound(...)`. However, in `src/sentry/integrations/mixins/issues.py`, `assignment_source` was added to the signature of `sync_status_outbound` (line 416) instead of `sync_assignee_outbound` (line 397), and concrete `IssueSyncIntegration` implementations of `sync_assignee_outbound` (such as Jira, GitHub, GitLab, VSTS) are neither updated to accept `assignment_source` nor guaranteed to accept `**kwargs` (or use `assignment_source` at all, since the check already happens in `installation.should_sync`). Any integration whose `sync_assignee_outbound` signature does not include `**kwargs` will raise `TypeError: sync_assignee_outbound() got an unexpected keyword argument 'assignment_source'` on every outbound assignee sync.
